title: Tripe Fritters with Brazilian Twist
description: A crispy Brazilian-inspired fritter recipe that features tender tripe as the main protein. This recipe adds a unique twist to traditional fritter recipes.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine tripe, cheese, onion, and egg. Mix well.
2. Add crushed fritters and breadcrumbs to the bowl. Mix until a thick batter forms.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the skillet.
5. Flatten the batter slightly with a spatula.
6. Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
7. Flip the fritters and cook for another 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
